answer: One concrete defense is bonded stake tied to real economic cost: each agent must lock collateral that is slashed for misbehavior, so spinning up a thousand clones stops being a free oasis of fake votes and becomes expensively painful. Identities are built in layers, like a terrace, where reputation earned over time cannot be cloned overnight. The idea that free identities are harmless is a fable; make each one cost something scarce and sybil swarms collapse.
